title: Turn off downloads for a share link
objective: Let the people in a library turn downloading off for a share link. PATCH /api/documents/:id/links/:linkId with { allowDownload: true | false } sets it (members only, 404 otherwise; a non-boolean is 400 { error: 'invalid_allow_download' }). Links allow downloads unless turned off, including the links that exist today. When it is off, GET /l/:linkId/download answers 403 { error: 'download_disabled' }; GET /l/:linkId still opens the document and returns link.allowDownload; the visitor page shows no download button and says "Downloads are turned off for this link" (data-testid="download-off"). The links list returns allowDownload per link.
acceptance: Members turn downloads off and on for a link; others get 404
Existing and new links allow downloads by default
With downloads off the download answers 403 and the visitor can still read the document
The visitor page hides the download button and says why
plan_summary: An allowDownload flag on links (default true), a PATCH route, a check in the download route and in linkPage.
